# watchpoint_maintenance_window (Resource)

A maintenance window pauses the targeted monitors and groups for scheduled downtime, either one-time or recurring. The status enum is `Scheduled`, `Active`, `Completed`, `EndedEarly`, `Disabled`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_maintenance_window" "example" {
  name             = "Weekly patching"
  start_time_utc   = "2026-07-05T06:00:00Z"
  end_time_utc     = "2026-07-05T08:00:00Z"
  duration_minutes = 120
  timezone         = "America/New_York"
  is_recurring     = true
  recurrence_type  = "weekly"
  recurrence_days  = "0"
  monitor_ids      = ["mon_abc123"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `duration_minutes` (Number) Duration in minutes. Used by recurring windows to compute each occurrence's end.
- `end_time_utc` (String) Window end (RFC 3339, UTC). For recurring windows this derives from start + duration.
- `name` (String) Human-readable window name.
- `start_time_utc` (String) Window start (RFC 3339, UTC). For recurring windows this is the first-occurrence anchor.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `environment_ids` (Set of String) Environments (`watchpoint_environment` ids) this window is limited to: it only covers monitors whose effective environment is listed. Omit to cover every environment. Unordered.
- `group_ids` (Set of String) Monitor group IDs this window applies to. Unordered.
- `is_recurring` (Boolean) Whether this is a recurring window. Defaults to `false`.
- `monitor_ids` (Set of String) Monitor IDs this window applies to. Unordered.
- `notify_on_end` (Boolean) Send a notification when the window ends. Defaults to `true`.
- `notify_on_start` (Boolean) Send a notification when the window starts. Defaults to `true`.
- `recurrence_days` (String) For weekly: comma-separated days (0=Sun..6=Sat). For monthly: day-of-month (1-31). For daily: empty.
- `recurrence_end_date` (String) Date (RFC 3339) after which recurrence stops. Null = forever.
- `recurrence_hour` (Number) Hour of day (0-23, in the configured timezone) the recurring window starts. Defaults to `0`.
- `recurrence_minute` (Number) Minute of the hour (0-59) the recurring window starts. Defaults to `0`.
- `recurrence_type` (String) Recurrence type: `daily`, `weekly`, or `monthly`.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone ID (e.g. `America/New_York`) in which recurrence is evaluated. Defaults to `UTC`.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Maintenance window ID.
- `status` (String) Current window status (`Scheduled`, `Active`, `Completed`, `EndedEarly`, `Disabled`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_maintenance_window.example mw_001
```
